name: ai.llmintel/llmintel
description: Check whether an LLM model id is deprecated, retiring, or retired — and what to migrate to. Normalized lifecycle data across OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure, AWS Bedrock, Google, and Cohere, sourced from each provider's own deprecation pages.

environmentVariables.name: LLMINTEL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. The catalog is public and needs no key; supplying one only raises the rate-limit budget.

environmentVariables.name: LLMINTEL_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Override the catalog origin (defaults to https://llmintel.ai). Useful for self-hosted or staging deployments.
